findings.summary: Two new flags duplicate what a script feeding rg -F -f already does; no issue discussing it first; a 30-line external script covers it
No end-to-end test of rg --base64; reverting the -F wiring or the expansion passes every test
No-duplicates invariant is false and expansion runs after the dedup pass
Empty pattern changes meaning versus plain -F
Docs describe a regex the code never builds; certificate line-wrap caveat; machine-written comments
Lean: about 75 lines removable (duplicate enum, tuple rebinding, redundant tests)

why: Finding 1 says the feature is already covered by -F -f and a small external script, and that no issue argued for new flags, which is the maintainer's reason (out of scope, use a wrapper script). The reviewer recommends discussion first rather than outright closing, so verdict is changes.
